name: 90 day BiL eligibility
description: Creates and approves a 2-year apprenticeship for Riley Brooks (DOB 2008-01-01, start 2026-04-01). PUTs a break in learning starting on day 45 (pause 2026-05-15), resuming 2028-01-01. The learner accrues 45 more actual days post-break, reaching 90 total on withdrawal date 2028-02-14. The 90-day incentive milestone is reached — both incentive payments should be generated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2028-02-13 (89 total days) — both incentives should be removed. Finally moves the return date forward one day to 2027-12-31, restoring 90 total days — both incentives should be regenerated. Then moves the withdrawal back one day to 2028-02-12 (89 total days) — both incentives should be removed again. Finally lengthens the break by one day (pause 2026-05-16), restoring 90 total days — both incentives should be regenerated.
